# Maxime Bonhomme

> Product-focused developer. Senior Frontend Engineer at IYK (2022 – present). Builds dynamic, creative products end to end.

## Experience
- IYK (2022 – present): Senior Frontend Engineer. Remix, Prisma, Effect, Tailwind.
- Everpress (2020 – 2022): Full Stack & Technical Lead, led a team of 5 engineers.
- Freelance (2016 – 2020): Front End Engineer for Marvel App, United Nations, Netflix, Dropbox Design.
- Neverbland (2014 – 2016): Front End Engineer.

## Side projects
- [ObserverKit](https://observerkit.com/): EU-hosted error tracking for JavaScript and React Native apps.
- [Podpod](https://podpod.me): generate podcasts from articles and newsletters.
- [Dolenn](https://www.instagram.com/dolenn.bzh): hot sauces made in Brittany.
- [Offline Nostalgia](https://offline-nostalgia.bonhomme.lol): generative art around the offline era.
- [Kinetic Spectrums](https://kineticspectru.ms/): generative on-chain NFTs.
